title: Add AI/LLM incident scenario (aiSlowResponse, aiRunawayAgent)
author: dpacheconr
body:
Fixes #3933

## Description

Adds two `demo.flagd.json` flags exercising the agent/LLM path:

- `aiSlowResponse` (`off`/`5sec`/`10sec`) — delays `ChatLLM`'s model call by
  the chosen amount, simulating LLM provider latency degradation.
- `aiRunawayAgent` (`off`/`on`) — nudges the agent's system prompt to keep
  calling tools instead of finishing, driving it toward
  `GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT` to simulate a runaway/looping agent.

Both are read via a new `src/agent/src/agents/feature_flags.py`, which wires
up an OpenFeature flagd provider for `agent` (it had none — every other
fault-flag service already does; this mirrors `src/recommendation`'s
`check_feature_flag` pattern).

Verified locally end to end (docker compose + a local k8s deployment):
toggling `aiSlowResponse=5sec` measurably added ~5s per model turn to
`/prompt` responses; both flags resolve correctly via flagd's OFREP endpoint.

## Related PRs

- [open-telemetry/opentelemetry-helm-charts#2385][helm-pr] — `agent` and
  `load-generator` chart-level env var fixes needed for this to run as a k8s
  deployment at all (unrelated to these flags specifically — found while
  testing this PR, see #3933).
- [open-telemetry/opentelemetry.io#11575][docs-pr] — Feature Flags docs
  update for `aiSlowResponse`/`aiRunawayAgent`.

## Checklist

- [x] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (via `.chloggen`)
- [x] Documentation has been updated — see the linked docs PR above.

[helm-pr]: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-helm-charts/pull/2385
[docs-pr]: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry.io/pull/11575

comments.author: julianocosta89
comments.text:
Thanks — this looks well put together: the flagd wiring mirrors the recommendation service pattern, both delays are async-safe (`asyncio.sleep` vs `time.sleep` split correctly), and the load-generator prompts replay against the bundled cassettes. 

Two small follow-ups: 

- Declare `gen_ai.input.prompt` in `telemetry-schema/services/load_generator.yaml` so the registry stays the single source of truth.
- Drop the shebang in `src/agent/src/agents/feature_flags.py` (shebang on a pure module; harmless but inconsistent with other agent modules.)

comments.author: ps48
comments.text:
@dpacheconr Thanks for the updates. The import-side-effect fix looks good (`init_feature_flags()` called from `run.py`), and `aiSlowResponse` works. But I still can't get `aiRunawayAgent` to loop under the default `USE_VCR=True`. I built the branch and toggled it on: flagd serves `20`, and I confirmed the agent injects the runaway instruction into the system prompt, but the response for `"Show all available products in the store."` is byte-identical to the flag-off response (4 messages, no repeated `get_recommendations`).
